notes.title: Drive Out -- Now available
notes.content: [h3]Differences from the demo version[/h3][p]Added new maps, mission types, items, and some new features.[/p][p]Revised the tutorial, making it clearer and easier to understand.[/p][p]Optimized some graphical effects to better reflect my initial expectations.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]Work with your companions at exorcism sites to uncover clues left by spirits and identify their types.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068211/ba10379ddb8d182bf9c4d6dd3d550ad1e70e56c1.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Different exorcism methods are used for different ghosts.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068211/e48df770021aa42ee949e20ae254307225f3ef9c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Successfully survive and complete the exorcism.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068211/ae080054211b07d01e5a9af39a8811bf89214a71.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New feature - Altar[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068211/26222a05983f58e9fee1640b0615a9e4f07954e2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Prolonged exorcism can negatively impact the exorcist's sanity, leading to mental illness.[/p][/*][*][p]The altar can restore sanity and cure these ailments, or harness this confusion to gain new insights.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068211/69caec6b42eb45db08ff48f2c79124e3e466d924.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added new maps, mission types, items, and some new features.
Revised the tutorial, making it clearer and easier to understand.
Optimized some graphical effects to better reflect my initial expectations.
Prolonged exorcism can negatively impact the exorcist's sanity, leading to mental illness.
The altar can restore sanity and cure these ailments, or harness this confusion to gain new insights.

notes.title: Demo 1.3.17 优化游戏体验 2025/4/10
notes.content:
[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[*] Optimized the tutorial level with more detailed content.
[*] Optimized the logic of the pendulum:
[*] 1. When the corresponding item is picked up, the pendulum will no longer sense it.
[*] 2. When the corresponding item is thrown out of the house, the pendulum will no longer sense it.
[*] Optimized the logic of ghosts: When hunting in anger, it will first move to the position where the player was last seen.
[*] Optimized player invitations: Now the invited player can receive invitations without staying in the main interface.
[*] Optimized ghost generation: Reduced the probability of continuously generating the same ghost.

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[*] Fixed a problem that could cause ghosts to get stuck
[*] Fixed the problem that the correct and incorrect props requested by the passenger plane players were not recorded

[*] Added a button to reset the save file

[*] Fixed the problem that the cross could not trap ghosts
[*] Deleted the collision box left in the magic circle
[*] Fixed the problem that the candlestick in the restaurant could not be picked up
[*] Fixed the problem that the pendulum glowed differently for each person

notes.title: [Demo version update] Updated on March 13, 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Demo 1.3.14[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Optimization[/h2]

[*] Provide a skip button for the beginning of the tutorial.
[*] Optimized the process of the tutorial. You can learn more detailed exorcism processes by re-experiencing it.
[*] Optimized the layout to make it look less strange in English.
[*] Added a new operation option =》Crouching mode (hold/switch)

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Content adjustment[/h2]

[*] Changed the shooting conditions of the spirit photo. Now it will not be considered a successful shot when it is completely revealed. Now it can be shot as long as it is in the flashing stage.
[*] Added CD for the door, and the spirit will no longer play the door frequently.
[*] Added CD for hunting. Except for some special cases, there will be no seamless continuous hunting.
[*] Adjusted the logic of cold rooms to better distinguish them from low temperatures
[expand type=details expanded=false]
Old: Reduced from 20 degrees to -1 degrees based on the anger of the spirit
New: Reduced from 5 degrees to -5 degrees based on the anger of the spirit
[/expand]
[*] Adjusted the hunting logic of multiplayer gatherings so that it will not hunt as frequently. However, the hunting probability will be higher when 4 people gather.

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[*] Fixed an issue where the spray sometimes could not be used
[*] Players outside the house are now invisible to the spirit, and the spirit will not block the door when seeing the players outside the house.
[*] Fixed an issue where the spirit would get stuck outside the house
[*] Fixed an issue where the spirit would sometimes hunt after being expelled
[*] Fixed an issue where the hand mirror could not be used to expel the dream shadow when participating in the game as a passenger plane
